text:
indra: Quick heads-up — running a short impact projection for the Lyra-Lite public beta (launch next Tue). Initial traffic evals + PLG funnel suggest bursty streaming sessions. TL;DR: expect ~18k-28k tokens/sec global peak, concentrated in APAC -> NA -> EU. Planning notes below. :eyes:

indra: rough numbers (peak day):
- sessions: 95k/day active, peak concurrency ~6.5k streaming sessions
- avg tokens/session: 1.2k
- estimated tokens/sec peak: 18k-28k
- estimated sustained throughput window: 3-4 hours/day at peak
- GPU hours (A100 equiv) needed: APAC 140 GPU-hrs/day, NA 160 GPU-hrs/day, EU 80 GPU-hrs/day (total ~380 GPU-hrs/day)
- 99p latency target collision: might need to route some traffic to quantized variant to keep SLOs

maya: can you break that down by region %? what margin assumptions are you using?

indra: region share assumption from early signups + traffic proxy: APAC 45%, NA 35%, EU 20%. Margin: provision for 1.5x peak headroom (safety) during first 7 days, then scale down to 1.25x if error/latency stable. Numbers above are pre-headroom; with 1.5x headroom total ~570 GPU-hrs/day.

sam: which GPUs are we assuming? H100 or A100? Also dedicated pools or shared hosted?

indra: baseline A100s for Dedicated pools in APAC/EU; NA mix H100 (for lower cost per token, but limited stock). Proposal: reserve additional 24 A100s in APAC for first week, convert to H100 rolling if demand sustains. Use Dedicated to avoid noisy neighbors and ensure consistent KV cache warmups.

leo: rough cost delta estimate? ballpark monthly delta for the reserved headroom?

indra: quick calc: 570 GPU-hrs/day => ~17,100 GPU-hrs/month. At blended cost ~ $1.1/GPU-hr (internal pricing model) => ~$18.8k/mo incremental; if we add H100 preferentially the cost could be ~ $2.0/GPU-hr but token efficiency reduces GPU-hrs by ~30% => ~ $24k/mo. These are order-of-magnitude, ops-fin should refine.

frank: any networking concerns? cross-region egress, websocket connection churn, LB capacity?

indra: yes — streaming increases long-lived connections. Estimate egress ~2TB/day APAC, 1.1TB/day NA, 0.5TB/day EU at peak. Need to check cloud egress quotas and LB connection limits; recommend 2x LB headroom and open ticket to request quota bump for APAC egress.

sam: can we fall back to a quantized model for non-critical routes to shave load? i.e., lyra-lite-q4 fallback?

indra: absolutely. Plan: routing policy that sends 20-30% of non-authenticated, low-SLA calls to lyra-lite-q4 during first 48 hours. q4 reduces GPU-hr cost ~30% but adds ~50-80ms median latency. We'll keep A/B monitors.

maya: autoscaler knobs? want a quick config we can test in staging before go-time.

indra: suggested HPA/proxy config below for continuous batching nodes — conservative scalePolicy: {"minReplicas":10,"maxReplicas":80,"targetRPS":1200}. Example k8s snippet we tested in perf:```yaml
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: lyra-lite-batcher
spec:
  minReplicas: 12
  maxReplicas: 72
  metrics:
  - type: Resource
    resource:
      name: cpu
      target:
        type: Utilization
        averageUtilization: 65
```
(we use an extra layer that batches by session window; this is tuning starting point).

ops-bot: deploy-bot posted: Runbook draft and staging perf results at https://internal.redwood/ops/lyra-lite-runbook (check traffic gating section).

frank: I'll open the egress quota request and LB headroom ticket.

leo: ops-fin: I'll ping finance for quick burn approval if we need to reserve capacity this week.

maya: Proposed action items: 1) reserve 24 A100s APAC + 12 in NA (indra) 2) deploy routing rule to send 25% low-SLA -> lyra-lite-q4 (sam/indra) 3) run staging soak with autoscaler snippet (maya/sam) 4) open egress/quotas & LB tickets (frank) 5) ops-fin cost sign-off (leo).

indra: thanks — I'll update the capacity sheet and post a short runbook PR. If we see adoption higher than 30% within 72h we trigger the H100 escalation plan. :thumbsup:
